title: What a Subsidised Member Meets of the Monthly Plan Premium for a Restored Coverage Month
content:
**Which record settles the share?** The low income premium subsidy recorded for the member on their Stand-Alone Medicare Part D Prescription Drug Plans record settles the share of the monthly plan premium the member meets for a restored coverage month on a Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan.

**What is the share where that record shows a full subsidy?** None of it, that is 0 per cent of the monthly plan premium.

**Where that record shows a seventy-five per cent subsidy?** A quarter of it, that is 25 per cent.

**Where that record shows a fifty per cent subsidy?** Half of it, that is 50 per cent.

**Where that record shows a twenty-five per cent subsidy?** Three quarters of it, that is 75 per cent.

**Where that record shows no subsidy at all?** The whole of it, that is 100 per cent.

**Worked on a hypothetical monthly plan premium of 120.00 USD.** A full subsidy leaves 0.00 USD met by the member for the restored coverage month; a seventy-five per cent subsidy leaves 30.00 USD; a fifty per cent subsidy leaves 60.00 USD; a twenty-five per cent subsidy leaves 90.00 USD; and a record showing no subsidy at all leaves the full 120.00 USD.
